items.title: The obstruction class for lifting an algebra along a surjection and the parametrization of solutions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its three assertions: there is a canonical class xi in Ext^2_B(L_{B/A}, N) whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the existence of a solution to the lifting equation; when solutions exist their isomorphism classes form a principal homogeneous space under Ext^1_B(L_{B/A}, N); and the automorphisms of a given solution are canonically Ext^0_B(L_{B/A}, N) (source lines 3168-3182). Parts (2) and (3) are obtained by transferring the deformation-theory statements along the identifications of the naive cotangent complex with the truncation of the cotangent complex and of H^0 with the differentials. Part (1) is proved by exhibiting the deformation-theoretic class xi' in Ext^1_A(NL_{A/A'}, N), rewriting it as a class on L_{A/A'} tensor B, and observing that the long exact sequence of the triangle for A' -> A -> B shows that solvability is exactly the condition that xi' lie in the image of the comparison map, so that the image xi in Ext^2_B(L_{B/A}, N) is the obstruction.
